view: The trend is down on 1W, 1D and 4H (below the 100W SMA by 7.0% and the 200D by 20.2%, gap 179.92-185.22 unfilled overhead, daily ADX 41.5). Thursday's 148.80 spring did not get follow-through: Friday closed at 162.85, the first daily close below the April 2026 swing low 164.27, and is now on trap watch (needs a close above 164.27 by 2026-11-18). Momentum is stretched but weekly RSI 32.53 on a completed bar is not oversold (<30). The long-term uptrend holds (200W SMA 31.8% below). Earnings on 2026-11-17 will matter more than any level, so I widen both tails and keep confidence moderate.

probabilities.defs: 2w ±5%, quarters ±10%, vs price_at_call 162.85 (Fri 2026-11-13 close, weekend run). next_2_weeks: up > +5% (close > 170.99), down < -5% (close < 154.71), range between, measured at the close on or before 2026-11-29 (i.e. Fri 2026-11-27). this_quarter: last close of Q4 2026 (2026-12-31); next_quarter: last close of Q1 2027 (2027-03-31); up > +10% (> 179.14), down < -10% (< 146.57), range between. up + range + down = 100.

evidence.point: Base rate: 33 up / 45 range / 22 down (n=258). I moved range -15, down +14 and up +1. Why: daily ATR is 9.98 (6.1%), so the ±5% band (154.71-170.99) is only about 1.6 ATRs wide in total, and earnings on 2026-11-17 fall inside the window. A post-print move bigger than half the band is likely, so range is cut. Down is favoured by the trend on every timeframe and by Friday's close below 164.27. The stretched-momentum conditionals keep up near its base rate.

Weekly RSI ≤36 conditional (n=13, overlapping windows): 2w 46/23/31, median +3.2%; 13w 69/0/31, median +21.5%. The 13w result has no range outcomes (up or down only), so this is a reversal-or-continuation setup, not a floor: 31% of cases still fell more than 10%. It is weak evidence. I use it only to keep next_quarter up near 42 rather than lower.

The 2w change is -20.4% (structure.two_week_change_pct), so this conditional applies: 2w 50/50/0, 13w 100/0/0, median +32.1%. But n=4 and the windows overlap, which makes it close to one episode. It is not strong enough to drop the down bucket below about 30% when a binary event is days away.

Base rate 39/43/18 → 31/37/32. The up threshold 179.14 sits just under the gap bottom (179.92), so up means reclaiming the 111W SMA (171.42) and the 100W SMA (175.06) and entering the gap. The down threshold 146.57 is just below the week's low (148.80), so down means the capitulation wick fails. Event variance plus a down-trending tape justify a roughly symmetric split.

Base rate 50/31/19 → 42/27/31. Over 13 weeks the drawdown of -33.1% from the ATH and the stretched-RSI and 2w-drop conditionals pull toward up. The weekly MACD crossing below its signal and the first weekly close below the 100W SMA pull toward down.

Weekly RSI14 is 32.53 (TradingView) / 32.5 (engine) on the COMPLETED bar of 2026-11-09, above the 30 threshold, so is_oversold = false. It is the lowest since 2023. At the April 2025 low weekly RSI was only 35.7, so a durable low does not need RSI below 30, and a reading near 32 does not prove a low either. This confirms the lessons-log entry of 2026-11-11: the reading is stretched but not oversold. Weekly RSI7 18.35 and Stoch RSI 0/0 show short-term exhaustion.

1W: MACD -1.99 below signal 4.5 (bearish cross), AO -6.83, CCI -266.3, Stoch K 16.88 < D 26.4, ADX 21.61. Price is below SMA10/20/50 (210.81/211.8/199.84) and the 100W SMA 175.06, above the 200W SMA 123.6. Summary SELL / MA STRONG_SELL. Counted with 1D and 4H as one momentum group.

Weekly candle: open 173.07, high 179.92, low 148.80, close 162.85 (-12.75%) on 2.34B shares. The lower wick (162.85→148.80) is about 1.4x the red body (173.07→162.85). That is a rejection of lower prices but not a classic hammer (2x body) and not a bullish close. The close is in the lower half of the range, just below the 0.65 retracement area.

1D: RSI14 24.86 (deeply stretched), ADX 41.5 (strong trend), MACD -14.23 below signal -10.11, AO -43.44. Price is below every daily MA (SMA10 182.75 through SMA200 204.19). HullMA9 at 161.64 is just below price. Stretched readings in a trend this strong can persist. They argue for a bounce attempt, not a trend change.

BBPCT printed two green up-triangles on the daily (Nov 10-13) and is back above 0 (3.75). Daily Stoch RSI K 11.55 > D 10.62. These are early bottoming signals on the owner's chart. They are information only, since the Equity Bottom checklist is a draft and not back-tested.

4H: RSI14 28.06, ADX 42.0, MACD -12.32 vs signal -11.09 (histogram -1.22, converging). Stoch RSI 46/44.5, Cipher B WT 2.05 and BBPCT 17.68 have already reset from oversold. The 4H bounce impulse was spent on Thursday-Friday without reclaiming the 4H SMA20 (183.18). HullMA9 161.38 is the first line under price.

Daily closes: 186.64, 178.67, 168.89, 173.73, 166.19, 162.85. Nov 12 broke 164.27 and 154.53 only intraday (low 148.80) and closed 166.19 above both: an intraday spring, not a closing break. Nov 13 opened 169.905, failed at 170.00, made a higher low at 158.39 and closed 162.85. That is the first daily close below the Apr 2026 swing low 164.27, which starts the trap clock: closes on 11-16, 11-17 and 11-18.

Volume: Nov 12 at 747.7M (about 5.2x the 60D average of 144.9M) and Nov 13 at 2.5x the 60D average. Monday's spike ratio was 3.2. Heavy volume at the low is consistent with capitulation, but Friday's red close on 2.5x volume shows supply is still present above 166-170.

The computed linear fibs (anchors 10.81 → 243.37) match the owner's chart labels: 0.65 = 161.97/161.98, 0.618 = 154.53, 0.5 = 127.09, 0.786 = 193.6. On a log scale the same ratios are far lower (0.618 = 74.07, 0.786 = 124.98), so the linear fibs are chart conventions, not hard support. They matter only where they line up with horizontal structure: 0.65 with the Apr 2026 low 164.27, and 0.618 with the Jul 2025 breakout closes 157.75.

The 100W SMA is 175.06 (price -7.0% below), with the owner's 111W SMA at 171.42 just under it. The prior weekly close (186.64) was above both, so this is the first weekly close below them. A weekly close back above 175.06 within 1-3 weeks would be the weekly version of a trap. The trap rule as written is about daily closes.

The gap from 179.92 (Nov 9 high) to 185.22 (Nov 6 low) is unfilled. It sits just above the this_quarter up threshold of 179.14 and below the proposed breakout trigger (weekly close above 186). Gaps after high-volume breakdowns often act as resistance on the first retest.
Touch rates from NVDA's history: 2w +5% 52.4 / -5% 41.0 / +10% 26.2 / -10% 17.1 / -20% 2.2 (unreachable); 6w -20% 11.2; 1q -20% 22.8 / -10% 48.5. All my triggers fall between 5% and 95%.

My four pages (tv_technicals 1W/1D/4H and tv_chart_owner) are ok and were read 2026-11-15, after event_cutoff_utc 2026-11-13T21:00Z, on completed bars. Options positioning is deferred, so put/call walls and gamma levels are unknown. That removes one check on whether 160/150 strike clusters are magnets into the print, and it is one reason my confidence is not higher.

key_levels.why: Proposed breakout-tranche trigger (a weekly close above it fills the gap and reclaims the 100W SMA). It is +14.2% from price: reachable within the quarter, not within 2 weeks in a normal tape.
Top of the unfilled gap (bottom 179.92). Expect resistance on the first retest. The this_quarter up threshold 179.14 sits just under the gap.
100W SMA, now overhead. This was the first weekly close below it. A weekly reclaim would mean the breakdown failed.
Owner's 111W SMA. Together with Friday's high (170.00) and the 2w up threshold (170.99), it makes 170-171.5 the first resistance band.

Apr 2026 swing low (the 2026 range low), broken on a daily close on 2026-11-13. Trap rule: a close back above it on 11-16, 11-17 or 11-18 makes the break a trap (bullish). No reclaim means the break is confirmed and the level becomes resistance.
Linear fib 0.65 and the bottom of the L1 zone, with the daily and 4H HullMA9 (161.64/161.38) just under it. Price is 0.5% above. A daily close below it is the next breakdown signal.
Friday's low, a higher low after Thursday's 148.80. Losing it on a close removes the short-term higher-low structure.
Linear fib 0.618 / L2 zone (with the Jul 2025 breakout closes at 157.75). It sits right at the 2w down threshold of 154.71.
Swing label on the owner's chart (date not in slice), just under the 0.618. A secondary support inside the L2-to-wick area.
The week's low (the capitulation wick on Nov 12). A daily close below it invalidates the spring. The this_quarter down threshold (146.57) is just below.
2024 range top. Together with the Jul 2025 breakout base (143.85) it forms the L3 confluence: horizontal structure, stronger than a fib.
200W SMA, the long-term trend line (price is 31.8% above it). L4 anchor. The SMA rises over time, so this anchor drifts upward.

what_would_change_my_mind: Bullish (trap): a daily close above 164.27 on 2026-11-16, 11-17 or 11-18 would mark Friday's break as a trap. I would move next_2_weeks to roughly 40/30/30.

Bullish, 1w window: a daily close above 170.99 by 2026-11-20 (above the Friday high, 111W SMA and 2w threshold; 1w +5% touch rate 35.8%) would move the 2w up bucket above 45. A further close above 175.06 (100W SMA) would raise this_quarter up toward 40.
Bullish structure: a weekly close above 186 by 2026-12-31 (gap filled, 100W reclaimed; 6w +10% touch rate 54.7%) would put this_quarter and next_quarter up above their base rates.
Bearish, 1w window: a daily close below 154.71 by 2026-11-20 (below the fib 0.618; 1w -5% touch rate 26.9%) would move the 2w down bucket above 50.
Bearish: a daily close below 148.80 by 2026-11-27 (2w -5%/-10% touch rates 41.0/17.1) would invalidate the spring. I would raise this_quarter down above 45 and expect a test of L3 at 141-145.
Bearish, quarter: a daily close below 140.76 by 2026-12-31 (6w -10% touch rate 37.6%) would break the 2024 range top. I would treat the 200W SMA zone (123.6-127) as the live target.

Momentum: a completed weekly bar (2026-11-20 or 2026-11-27) with RSI14 below 30 would be the first real weekly oversold reading since before 2023. It is weak evidence, and I would give next_quarter up only a modest lift (+3 to +5).
notes_for_chair: Expected (not triggers): earnings 2026-11-17 after close; weekly closes 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-27 (the 2w bucket resolves at the Fri 2026-11-27 close; Thanksgiving is 11-26). Only the outcomes are triggers, as listed in what_would_change_my_mind.

Before vs after earnings: before the print (11-16 and 11-17 sessions) there is only one technical question, whether 164.27 is reclaimed (trap) or 161.98 is lost on a close. After the print, the 11-18 close is both the third trap close and the earnings reaction. I would roughly halve the weight on these pre-print numbers and re-anchor on 148.80 below and 170.99/175.06 above.

Ladder Audit, status: PROPOSED 2026-11-11, budget null, owner has not approved levels or budget. History shows all four orders 'resting (proposed)'. No fills are recorded and no rows have been dropped. Earnings blackout runs 2026-11-12 to 2026-11-17 and L1 was touched intraday inside it. The committee audits only. Any change is the owner's decision, and nothing here is a suggestion to place or execute orders.

Ladder Audit, anchor quality. L1 (162-164) has weakened: one of its two anchors, the Apr 2026 low 164.27, was broken on a daily close on 11-13 and is resistance unless reclaimed by 11-18, which leaves only the linear fib 0.65 (a chart convention). L2 (154-157) is moderate: fib 0.618 plus the Jul 2025 breakout closes at 157.75, both traded through intraday on 11-12 and reclaimed. L3 (141-145) is the strongest: two horizontal structure levels, the 2024 range top 140.76 and the Jul 2025 base 143.85. L4 (124-128) is strong but drifting: the 200W SMA rises each week, and fib 0.5 is 127.09.

Ladder Audit, spacing: 4.8% / 8.7% / 13.5% gaps, widening geometrically, which is sound. But L1-to-L2 (4.8%) is under one daily ATR (6.1%), so in this volatility L1 and L2 behave as one level and can both fill in a single session (as nearly happened on 11-12). There is no level between the L2 bottom (154) and the L3 top (145), and the week's capitulation low of 148.80 sits in that gap. This is information for the owner, not a proposal.

Ladder Audit, fill timing. L1 is at price (+0.1%) and will very likely trade before earnings. L2 (-4.5%) could be reached before the print (1w -5% touch rate 26.9%), but the main path to it is a weak post-print reaction. L3 (-12.2%) is a post-earnings level (2w -10% touch rate 17.1%, 1q 48.5%); filling it means the this_quarter down bucket (below 146.57) is also in play. L4 (-22.6%) is out of reach in 2 weeks (2w -20% touch rate 2.2%) and has a 22.8% quarter touch rate, yet it carries 40% of the weights (3.0 of 7.5). That is a sizing and deployment question for the chair and the owner.

Breakout tranche: the trigger is a weekly close above 186 (+14.2%). It is consistent with the structure (gap plus 100W). The 111W (171.42) and 100W (175.06) reclaims come first and are the earlier warnings.

Out of my lane: the CEO exit on 11-12 and TB2 are the chair's call. The rules say any thesis break pauses all buying, which would make the ladder discussion moot. I treat the governance story only as a factor that widens variance.

Weekly RSI: do not call it oversold. 32.53 on a completed bar is above 30 (lessons-log 2026-11-11). The stretched-RSI base rates (n=13) are bimodal at 13w (69 up / 0 range / 31 down), so 'stretched' means a large move in either direction, not a guaranteed bounce.

Missing evidence: options positioning is deferred (strike magnets are unknown). The Equity Bottom checklist is a draft and not back-tested, so the BBPCT triangles and volume spike are information only. The sentiment pages are stale but are not in my lane.

Pre-mortem: if this is badly wrong in three months, the likeliest reason is that 148.80 was the capitulation low (the 5x-volume wick and the n=4/n=13 conditionals were right) and I over-weighted the trend and event risk. The other possibility is that the governance shock plus a weak guide started a regime break that took price through L3 toward the 200W SMA.
